dedupe_keys.name: amenagements cyclables dans le departement du nord

description: Aménagements cyclables dans le département du Nord is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. This data represents the cycling facilities on the departmental roads of the North. Bicycle paths (clean site for cyclists) and bicycle strips (recommended lane on the roadway) are distinguished. (Locations: R:\Catalogue\donneesSIG\Reseaurouteferre\Reseaucyclable.gdb\Cyclo\cyclablebasevoiedep//N:\documentations and sources products\projectportal\dataandfile sde\sde\prod\reference\reseauroutierferre@referenceprod.sde\reference.reseauroutierferre.cd59cyclable). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Cycling facilities in the department of the North" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include nord, voies, transport, pistes cyclables, cyclable, velo. The listing shows 2021-07-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
